models.name: iPhone
models.description: The first iPhone introduced by Apple, featuring a 3.5-inch multi-touch display and a 2-megapixel camera. It revolutionized the smartphone industry with its capacitive touchscreen and iOS operating system.

models.name: iPhone 3G
models.description: The second-generation iPhone introduced 3G network support and GPS. It featured a plastic back design and improved battery life, making it more accessible to a broader audience.

models.name: iPhone 3GS
models.description: The third-generation iPhone featured a faster processor and introduced video recording. It was marketed with the 'S' standing for speed, offering improved performance over its predecessor.

models.name: iPhone 4
models.description: The iPhone 4 introduced a全新的 design with a stainless steel frame and glass back. It featured the Retina display, a 5-megapixel camera with LED flash, and the front-facing camera for FaceTime.

models.name: iPhone 4S
models.description: The iPhone 4S introduced Siri, Apple's intelligent personal assistant. It featured an improved 8-megapixel camera, dual-core A5 chip, and was available in black and white.

models.name: iPhone 5
models.description: The iPhone 5 featured a taller 4-inch Retina display, the A6 chip, and introduced Lightning connector. It was thinner and lighter than its predecessor, with aluminum unibody construction.

models.name: iPhone 5C
models.description: The iPhone 5C was Apple's first colorful iPhone, featuring a polycarbonate shell. It offered similar specifications to the iPhone 5 but at a more affordable price point.

models.name: iPhone 5S
models.description: The iPhone 5S introduced Touch ID fingerprint sensor and the A7 chip with 64-bit architecture. It featured a new gold color option and improved camera capabilities.

models.name: iPhone 6
models.description: The iPhone 6 introduced a larger 4.7-inch Retina HD display and a thinner design. It featured the A8 chip, improved camera with Focus Pixels, and Apple Pay support.

models.name: iPhone 6 Plus
models.description: The iPhone 6 Plus was Apple's first phablet with a 5.5-inch display. It featured optical image stabilization, landscape mode, and the same A8 chip as the iPhone 6.

models.name: iPhone 6S
models.description: The iPhone 6S introduced 3D Touch and the A9 chip. It featured an improved 12-megapixel camera with Live Photos and the new Rose Gold color option.

models.name: iPhone 6S Plus
models.description: The iPhone 6S Plus featured a 5.5-inch display with 3D Touch and optical image stabilization. It offered the same A9 chip and 12-megapixel camera as the 6S.

models.name: iPhone SE (1st generation)
models.description: The first-generation iPhone SE combined the popular 4-inch design of the iPhone 5S with the powerful A9 chip. It offered flagship performance in a compact form factor.

models.name: iPhone 7
models.description: The iPhone 7 introduced a new Jet Black finish, water resistance, and removed the headphone jack. It featured the A10 Fusion chip and improved dual-camera system on the Plus model.

models.name: iPhone 7 Plus
models.description: The iPhone 7 Plus featured a dual-camera system with 2x optical zoom and Portrait mode. It had a larger 5.5-inch display and the same A10 Fusion chip.

models.name: iPhone 8
models.description: The iPhone 8 featured a glass back design enabling wireless charging. It was powered by the A11 Bionic chip and introduced Portrait Lighting effects.

models.name: iPhone 8 Plus
models.description: The iPhone 8 Plus featured a dual-camera system with Portrait Lighting and the A11 Bionic chip. It offered wireless charging and the same glass back design.

models.name: iPhone X
models.description: The iPhone X (10th anniversary edition) introduced the edge-to-edge Super Retina display, Face ID, and the TrueDepth camera system. It featured the A11 Bionic chip.

models.name: iPhone XR
models.description: The iPhone XR featured a 6.1-inch Liquid Retina display and the A12 Bionic chip. It offered a more affordable option with Face ID and a single-lens camera.

models.name: iPhone XS
models.description: The iPhone XS featured a 5.8-inch Super Retina display and the A12 Bionic chip. It introduced Smart HDR and improved water resistance.

models.name: iPhone XS Max
models.description: The iPhone XS Max featured a 6.5-inch Super Retina display, making it Apple's largest iPhone at the time. It offered the same A12 Bionic chip and camera system.

models.name: iPhone 11
models.description: The iPhone 11 featured a dual-camera system with Ultra Wide lens and the A13 Bionic chip. It offered improved battery life and a new Midnight Green color.

models.name: iPhone 11 Pro
models.description: The iPhone 11 Pro introduced a triple-camera system with Ultra Wide, Wide, and Telephoto lenses. It featured the Super Retina XDR display and the A13 Bionic chip.

models.name: iPhone 11 Pro Max
models.description: The iPhone 11 Pro Max featured a 6.5-inch Super Retina XDR display and the same triple-camera system as the 11 Pro. It offered the best battery life in the lineup.

models.name: iPhone SE (2nd generation)
models.description: The second-generation iPhone SE featured the A13 Bionic chip and a 4.7-inch Retina HD display with Touch ID. It offered flagship performance in a compact, affordable design.

models.name: iPhone 12 mini
models.description: The iPhone 12 mini was Apple's smallest 5G smartphone with a 5.4-inch Super Retina XDR display. It featured the A14 Bionic chip and a dual-camera system.

models.name: iPhone 12
models.description: The iPhone 12 introduced a flat-edge design with Ceramic Shield and 5G support. It featured the A14 Bionic chip and a dual-camera system with Night mode.

models.name: iPhone 12 Pro
models.description: The iPhone 12 Pro featured a triple-camera system with LiDAR Scanner and a stainless steel frame. It offered a 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR display and the A14 Bionic chip.

models.name: iPhone 12 Pro Max
models.description: The iPhone 12 Pro Max featured a 6.7-inch Super Retina XDR display and the best camera system in the lineup with a larger sensor and improved optical zoom.

models.name: iPhone 13 mini
models.description: The iPhone 13 mini featured a 5.4-inch Super Retina XDR display with smaller notch. It offered the A15 Bionic chip, improved battery life, and advanced dual-camera system.

models.name: iPhone 13
models.description: The iPhone 13 featured a 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR display with a smaller notch. It introduced Cinematic mode, Sensor-shift OIS, and the A15 Bionic chip.

models.name: iPhone 13 Pro
models.description: The iPhone 13 Pro introduced ProMotion display with 120Hz refresh rate and the A15 Bionic chip. It featured a triple-camera system with macro photography and Cinematic mode.

models.name: iPhone 13 Pro Max
models.description: The iPhone 13 Pro Max featured a 6.7-inch ProMotion display with 120Hz refresh rate. It offered the best battery life in the lineup and the same advanced camera system.

models.name: iPhone SE (3rd generation)
models.description: The third-generation iPhone SE featured the A15 Bionic chip and 5G support in a compact 4.7-inch design with Touch ID. It offered flagship performance at an affordable price.

models.name: iPhone 14
models.description: The iPhone 14 featured a 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR display with the A15 Bionic chip. It introduced Action mode, Crash Detection, and improved low-light camera performance.

models.name: iPhone 14 Plus
models.description: The iPhone 14 Plus featured a large 6.7-inch Super Retina XDR display with excellent battery life. It offered the same A15 Bionic chip and improved camera features.

models.name: iPhone 14 Pro
models.description: The iPhone 14 Pro introduced the Dynamic Island, Always-On display, and a 48-megapixel main camera. It featured the A16 Bionic chip and a new Deep Purple color.

models.name: iPhone 14 Pro Max
models.description: The iPhone 14 Pro Max featured a 6.7-inch Always-On display with Dynamic Island. It offered the best camera system with a 48MP main sensor and the A16 Bionic chip.

models.name: iPhone 15
models.description: The iPhone 15 introduced the Dynamic Island and a USB-C port. It featured the A16 Bionic chip, a 48-megapixel main camera, and a new color-infused glass back.

models.name: iPhone 15 Plus
models.description: The iPhone 15 Plus featured a 6.7-inch Super Retina XDR display with Dynamic Island. It offered the A16 Bionic chip and a 48MP main camera in a larger form factor.

models.name: iPhone 15 Pro
models.description: The iPhone 15 Pro featured a titanium frame, the A17 Pro chip, and a USB-C port. It introduced the Action button and offered advanced camera capabilities with a 48MP main sensor.

models.name: iPhone 15 Pro Max
models.description: The iPhone 15 Pro Max featured a 6.7-inch display with titanium frame and the A17 Pro chip. It introduced a tetraprism telephoto lens with 5x optical zoom.

models.name: iPhone 16
models.description: The iPhone 16 featured the A18 chip and a new Camera Control button. It introduced Apple Intelligence capabilities and improved battery life in a 6.1-inch form factor.

models.name: iPhone 16 Plus
models.description: The iPhone 16 Plus featured a 6.7-inch display with the A18 chip and Camera Control. It offered excellent battery life and Apple Intelligence capabilities.

models.name: iPhone 16 Pro
models.description: The iPhone 16 Pro featured a 6.3-inch display with the A18 Pro chip and Camera Control. It offered an improved 48MP Ultra Wide camera and Apple Intelligence.

models.name: iPhone 16 Pro Max
models.description: The iPhone 16 Pro Max featured a 6.9-inch display with the A18 Pro chip. It offered the best camera system with a 48MP Fusion lens and 5x telephoto zoom.

models.name: iPhone 16e
models.description: The iPhone 16e is an affordable addition to the iPhone 16 family. It features the A18 chip, a 6.1-inch display, and a single 48MP camera with 2x telephoto capability.

models.name: iPhone 17
models.description: The iPhone 17 features a 6.3-inch display and starts with 256GB storage. It includes Apple Intelligence and advanced camera capabilities.

models.name: iPhone 17 Air
models.description: The iPhone 17 Air is Apple's thinnest iPhone ever with a 6.5-inch display. It features the A19 Pro chip and a sleek, lightweight design.

models.name: iPhone 17 Pro
models.description: The iPhone 17 Pro features a 6.3-inch display with titanium frame. It offers advanced camera capabilities and the latest A19 Pro chip.

models.name: iPhone 17 Pro Max
models.description: The iPhone 17 Pro Max features a 6.9-inch display with titanium frame and the A19 Pro chip. It offers the best camera system and battery life in the lineup.

models.name: iPhone 17e
models.description: The iPhone 17e is an entry-level iPhone featuring a 6.1-inch display and the A18 chip. It offers essential iPhone features at a more accessible price point.
